title: Don’t buy
text:
Don’t buy. I returned. I’m not a picky person, I just wanted a sectioned dish with a lid to take treat/fruit trays to homes of my friends. Not only do the lids not secure to the base in any way - I had to bend the pieces to get them to simply line up. I was really disappointed. I returned and purchased one with a locking lid and am now extremely pleased.
If you plan on tossing the lid and only using the bottom then go for it! Super cute bottom!

product_metadata.title: SOUJOY 2 Pack Divided Serving Tray with Lid, 11'' Plastic Round Veggie Tray, Reusable 5 Compartment Party Platter for Candy, Appetizer, Snack, Fruit, Nuts, Veggie, Parties
features: Premium Quality: SOUJOY Serving trays is made of food grade polypropylene(PP), BPA free, which makes them more durable and resist break, and very safe and healthy to put any food you like. Dishwasher safe.
Package Include: 2 pack 5 sectional serving trays. Size of each container: 10.4 inch in diameter, 2.8 inch in height. Color: green and pink. It can stacked to save storage space.

Lid Design: The serving container is safety design with protection lid and handles, easy to open. It is dustproof and prevents the snacks from being spilled and easy to take by hands. The lid is transparent, so that you can know the capacity in one glimpse.

Convenient to Use: Each department of the veggie tray can take out off easily, making it convenient to refill food for parties, so you you just need to take the compartment away from your guest to replenish.

Widely Use: The serving container can be widely used for serving candies, nuts, snacks, charcuterie, crackers, cheeses, appetizers, fruits, veggies, meats and others. Ideal for home, caterers, office parties, banquet facilities and any other indoor/outdoor events.
